audit.corrected: Chart re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers: Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Rumble, with ratings moved. Row 6 set to Rumble rather than the packet's Skill because whys[6] and spikes[3] both describe a takeover.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three claims to fix. (1) 'Ragnarok cleanses his E harpoon slow' twice, plus 'makes you immune to the kite'. Ragnarok grants immunity to disables while attacking; Electro Harpoon applies a slow and a magic resist shred, and a slow is not cleared by it — the same finding the Nasus matchup produced for Wither. (2) 'Walk through Equalizer CC-immune' — Equalizer is damage and a slow, so immunity does not make crossing it free; you take the burn either way. (3) wants.you[0] calls Scrap Shield a 'W-dash'. It is a shield with a burst of move speed, not a dash.
audit.why: The page builds its level-6 plan on a cleanse that does not happen and on walking through a damage zone as if it were harmless. The honest version is better advice anyway: Reckless Swing's true damage ignores the magic resist he stacks, so you commit through the burn rather than expecting to be freed from it.
audit.corrected: Slow-immunity claims removed and replaced with what actually carries the fight — true damage through MR, and Ragnarok used for his disables. Electro Harpoon given its two-charge behaviour, Scrap Shield restated as a 6s shield plus speed burst, The Equalizer as the 130s flame wall. The real tell named: his Heat gauge, not Scrap Shield's cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page tells the player to track Scrap Shield and commit 'on its cooldown'. Scrap Shield is 6 seconds flat — it is never meaningfully down. Electro Harpoon is 0.5s with two charges, so it cannot be baited either.
audit.why: Both 'cooldowns' the page asks the player to track are effectively always available. The genuinely punishable state is a cold Heat gauge: outside Danger Zone his Flamespitter damage is far lower, and at 100% Heat he cannot cast at all.
audit.corrected: Cooldown breakdown, interactions line, do's entry and all-in window rewritten around reading the Heat gauge instead of a 6s shield.

notes: Two kinds of correction here. First the mechanics: the page told the player Ragnarok cleanses Electro Harpoon's slow and lets him walk through Equalizer 'CC-immune'. Ragnarok is immunity to disables held while attacking — it does not clear slows (same finding as Wither in the Nasus matchup) and it does not stop Equalizer's damage. Rewritten around the thing that does carry the fight: Reckless Swing is true damage, so the magic resist Rumble stacks buys him nothing. Scrap Shield was also called a 'W-dash'; it is a shield with a speed burst. Second the sequencing: the entire page said to commit 'on Scrap Shield's cooldown', but Scrap Shield is a flat 6s and Electro Harpoon is 0.5s with two charges — neither is ever down. The real punishable state is a cold Heat gauge, which is now what the page tells him to read. Packet suspectName 'Drop Equalizer' is a false positive. Chart flipped four rows in matched pairs.
